# Restricted Git corpus

Fixtures are generated by `infra/clone/fixture.py` as known bounded object/pack
bytes; that process does not invoke Git or parse a repository. Only disposable
KVM guests run the Git parser. Do not clone, checkout, unpack or build this
corpus on the management/developer host.

`TestRealCloneCorpus` consumes these fixtures through the real M05 broker.
The harness preserves per-case result frames, expected SHAs, packet captures,
origin/DNS/canary observations and cleanup evidence.

| Cases | Expected behavior |
|---|---|
| `good`, `executable`, `symlink`, `nested`, `v6`, `directory-link` | Successful tracked export, exact SHA, verified content/modes/internal link, no `.git` |
| `moving` | Fail closed retaining the original SHA when the new advertisement no longer offers it |
| `mismatch`, `corrupt`, `malformed`, `sha256` | Deny wrong/malformed object or unsupported format |
| `submodule`, `modules`, `attributes`, `lfs` | Deny unsupported features without secondary fetch or execution |
| `escape`, `cycle`, `collision`, `metadata-path`, `context-escape`, `config-symlink`, `directory-cycle`, `context-return` | Deny unsafe tree/context/config |
| `timeout`, `object-limit`, `context-limit`, `entry-limit`, `ref-limit`, `transfer-limit`, `adv-limit`, `deep-tree`, `long-path`, `object-count`, `expanded-limit`, `huge-object`, `huge-ref-list`, `log-flood` | Bound/deny resource abuse; the 65 MiB expanded-object fixture and progress flood are generated within fixed lab budgets |
| `redirect`, `redirect-same`, `redirect-301`, `redirect-303`, `redirect-307`, `redirect-308` | Deny redirect before target access |
| `rebind`, `private`, `metadata`, `infra`, `mixed`, `mapped`, `badcert`, `dnsfail` | Deny unsafe destination, certificate or resolution; no forbidden canary arrivals |
| `stall-fetch` | Controlled delay used only by cancellation, worker-loss and independent-expiry tests |

Every guest also receives poisoned global config/environment, helper/filter/hook
sentinels and a fresh isolated HOME; none may execute. Transport/ref/path
injection and malformed job/result/device cases additionally run in contract,
parser and provisioner unit/fuzz tests, without executing hostile Git locally.
